description: Follows a passage's connections outward — voted cross-references plus quotations and parallels between books — one to three steps (depth, default 2), and returns the most strongly connected verses (20 by default, limit 1-40) with their text, hops from the start, strength (it grows with the number of short paths that reach the verse) and how each was reached. Example: the connections of Passover outward from Exodus 12. Use when the user asks to follow a theme or passage outward through the Bible.

follow.description: both, xref (cross-references only) or quotes (quotations and parallels only)

limit.description: how many results to return (1-40, default 20)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

reference.description: a verse, short range or chapter

name: trace_theme
title: Trace a theme
